summary: Comprehensive testing of AI Listing Assistant feature. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%) - conversation CRUD, image upload (JPEG/PNG/WEBP), file rejection (non-image, oversized), SSE streaming, message persistence, user scoping. Frontend: All UI elements verified - FAB button, panel, quick actions, chat input, send/attach/history/new-chat/close buttons. Chat functionality working - messages send, AI responses stream in real-time with Gemini integration. FAB correctly shows only for employees (not admin).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend properly validates image types (JPEG/PNG/WEBP only) and size (5MB limit)
SSE streaming works correctly with delta and done event types
Conversations are properly scoped to authenticated user (user A cannot access user B's conversations)
Messages are persisted in MongoDB with both user and assistant messages
Frontend uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements (good for testing)
Quick action buttons correctly fill input with marketplace-specific prompts
AI responses render with ReactMarkdown for proper formatting

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 passed, 2 skipped due to admin token unavailability)

context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Listing Assistant feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: POST /api/ai/conversations (create), GET /api/ai/conversations (list), GET /api/ai/conversations/{id} (get with messages), DELETE /api/ai/conversations/{id} (delete), POST /api/ai/upload-image (upload JPEG/PNG/WEBP under 5MB), GET /api/ai/images/{id} (serve image), POST /api/ai/conversations/{id}/messages (send message, returns SSE stream). Frontend: FAB button at bottom-right (data-testid='ai-assistant-fab') only shows for employees. Panel (data-testid='ai-assistant-panel') has welcome screen with quick actions for eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, FB Marketplace. Chat supports text and image attachments. Uses Gemini via emergentintegrations library with gemini-3-flash-preview model.
